items.text: Disanka dia bidia bidi kabi ne luevene diakadi ba buibi, badi badibikila ne, Kuhita kua Yehowa.
Bakuidi banene ba Nzambi ne bafundi bakakeba mua kumushiha, bua bobo bakadi batshina bantu.
Satana wakahuela munda mua Yudasa, wakadibo babikila ne Isakaliote, yeye wakadi wabo wa ba dikumi ne babidi.
Wakumuka biandi wakasangisha dî ne bakuidi banene ne tuhita tua balami ba ntempelo bualu bua kumufileye mu bianza biabo.
Bakadi ne disanka, bakamulaya ne, Netukuhe mpalata.
Yeye wakitabusha, wakakeba mua kumufila mu bianza biabo tshisumbu tshia bantu katshîhu.
Dituku dia usanka dia bidia kabî biela luevene diakafika, diakadibo ne bualu bua kushiha bana ba mikoko ya Kuhita kua Yehowa.
Yeye wakatuma Petelo ne Yone ne, Yai nutulongoluele Kuhita kua Yehowa bua tuetu kudia.
Bakamukonka ne, Udi musue tuetu tulongoluela kudi kunyi?
Yeye wakabambila ne, Hanuabuela mu musoko, nenusangile ne mulume mutuale mulondo wa mai; numulonde mu nsubu wabueleye.
Nuambile muena nsubu ne, Muyishi udi ukukonka ne, Nsubu wa buenyi unadila bidia bia Kuhita kua Yehowa ne bayidi banyi udi hanyi?
Yeye neanuleshe nsubu mimene wa mulu mmuana kulongolola bintu bionso; nulongololemu.
Bakaya, bakamona bi muakabambileye: bakalongolola Kuhita kua Yehowa.
Hakafika diba wakashikama ku mesa ne bapostolo.
Wakabambila ne, Nakutamba kusua bua kudia nʼenu bidia ebi bia Kuhita kua Yehowa, diambedi tshi muanze kukenga;
ndi nuambila ne, Tshiona ndia bintu ebi kabidi tô ne hashikishabo malu onso mu bukelenge bua Nzambi.
Bakamuhesha luhanza; hakasakidileye Nzambi, wakamba ne, Angatai, nuabanyangane;
ndi nuambila ne, Tshiena nua mai a mamuma a nvinyo kabidi tô ne halua bukelenge bua Nzambi.
Yeye wakamema mutanda wa bidia; hakasakidileye Nzambi, wakautshibula, wakaha bayidi bandi, wakamba ne, Eu udi mubidi wanyi udi unuhebua; enzai nunku bua kunvuluka.
Hakashikishabo kudia, yeye wakamema luhanza muomumue kabidi, wakamba ne, Luhanza elu ludi dihungila dihia-dihia dia mu mashi anyi akunumatshishilabo hanshi.
Kadi, tangilai, tshianza tshia udi untungila tshitungu tshidi nʼanyi ha mesa.
Bulelela, Muana wa muntu udi uya bu muakasungulabo, kadi mulau neulue kudi wakumutungila tshitungu.
Bobo bakabanga kukonkangana ne, Nganyi nenze bualu ebu?
Bakadi belangana mpata ne, Bakusungula nganyi bua yeye kutamba bakuabo?
Yeye wakabambila ne, Banfumu ba bantu ba bisamba bia bende badi babakokesha ne diambu, ne banfumu babo badi babikidibua ne, Benji ba bilengelele.
Kadi nuenu, kanuikadi nunku; udi mutambe bakuabo munkatshi muenu alue biandi muakunyi; udi biandi nfumu alue muena mudimu.
Udi mutambe mukuabo nganyi, udi mushikame ku mesa, anyi udi umuhetesha bia kudia? Udi mushikame ku mesa kena mutambe, anyi? Kadi meme udi munkatshi muenu bu muena mudimu.
Kadi nuenu mbakunanukila nʼanyi mu makenga anyi;
ndi nuha bukelenge bu muakumpa Tatu wanyi bukelenge,
bua nuenu kudia ne kunua ku mesa anyi mu bukelenge buanyi; nenushikame mu nkuasa ya butumbi nulumbuluisha bisamba dikumi ne bibidi bia Isalele.
Yesu wakamba ne, Simona, Simona, mona, Satana wakalomba mua kunuangata bualu bua kunusengeye bu ntete;
kadi nakukulombela wewe Nzambi bua ditabusha diebe kadihangi; wewe, hawakudimuka, ukoleshe mitshima ya bana benu.
Petelo wakamuambila ne, Mukelenge, ndi ne dikima dia mua kuya nʼebe ne mu nsubu wa lukanu ne ku lufu.
Yeye wakamba ne, Petelo, ndi nkuambila ne, Tshitala katshî tshianze kusama lelu wewe neuvile misangu isatu ne, Tshiena mumumanye.
Yeye wakabambila ne, Hanakanutuma kanui ne mukaba ne tshibombo ne bisabata, nuakuhanga tshintu, anyi? Bakamba ne, Nasha.
Yeye wakabambila ne, Kadi katataka, udi ne mukaba awangate ne tshibombo kabidi; udi kai ne muele wa nvita ahane kazaku kandi, ausumbe.
Bualu bua ndi nuambila ne, Budibo nʼabu mbua kushikisha kundi di edi didi difunda ne, Bakamubala hohamue ne bantu babi; bualu bua nebashikishe mei onso akafundabo bualu buanyi.
Bakamba ne, Mukelenge, tangila, miele ya nvita ibidi kayiyi. Yeye wakabambila ne, Kuakushika.
Yeye wakaluhuka, wakaya ku mukuna wa Oleve, bu muakadi tshilele tshiandi; bayidi bakamulonda.
Hakafikeye ku muaba au, wakabambila ne, Nutendelele Nzambi bua nuenu kanuhonyi mu mateyi.
Yeye wakadi nkayandi bu ntanta wa kuela dibue diafika; wakatua binu hanshi, wakatendelela Nzambi,
wakamba ne, Tatu, biwasua, ungumushile luhanza elu; kadi bualu buenjibue bu mûdi musue, kabuenjibu bu mundi musue.
Muanjelo wa mu diulu wakamueneka kudiye, wakamukolesha.
Wakatamba kukenga ne kanyinganyinga, wakatendelela Nzambi bikole; luanga luakahatuka mamata manene hamʼbidi handi bu mashi amata hanshi.
Hakajukeye ku kutendelela kuandi, wakalua kudi bayidi, wakabasangana balale tulu bualu bua kanyinganyinga,
wakabebesha ne, Nudi baladile tulu tshinyi? Jukai, nutendelele Nzambi bua kanuhonyi mu mateyi.
Hakadiye wamba nunku, monai, tshisumbu tshia bantu tshiakalua, mukuabo wabo wa ba dikumi ne babidi, dina diandi Yudasa, wakalua ku mpala kuabo; wakalua ha buihi ne Yesu bua kutuangana nʼandi mishiku.
Kadi Yesu wakamuebesha ne, Yudasa, udi utungila Muana wa muntu tshitungu ku kutuangana kua mishiku, anyi?
Bakadi ha buihi ne Yesu, hakamonabo ne bualu buakadi ha kulua, bakamuebesha ne, Mukelenge, tubatahe ne muele, anyi?
Mukuabo wakataha muntu wa muakuidi munene, wakamukosa ditshu dia tshianza tshia bukole.
Kadi Yesu wakandamuna ne, Nubalekele, benze. Wakalenga tshianza ku ditshu diandi, wakamuhingishiladi.
Yesu wakakonka bakuidi banene ne tuhita tua balami ba ntempelo ne bakulu bakadi bamuluile ne, Nuakulua ne miele ne bibonge bu mudibo bakuata munyengi munyi?
Hanakadi nʼenu mu ntempelo ku dituku ku dituku, kanuakandenga bianza; kadi edi diba ndienu, ne bukokeshi bua mîdima.
Bakamukuata, bakaluhuka nʼandi, bakalua nʼandi mu nsubu wa muakuidi munene. Petelo wakaha londa ha bule ha bule.
Hakatemeshabo kahia nu bunene bua luhangu, hakashikamabo hohamue, Petelo wakadi mushikame munkatshi muabo.
Mukashi muenji wa mudimu wakamutangila hakadiye mushikame ku dinkenka dia kahia, wakamutangila talala, wakamba ne, Muntu eu kabidi wakadi ne Yesu.
Yeye wakavila ne, Mukashiana, tshiena mumumanye.
Hakaleha tshituha, mukuabo wakamutangila, wakamuambila ne, Wewe kabidi udi umue wabo. Petelo wakamba ne, Nasha, mulumiana, tshiena wabo.
Hakahita bu tshituha tshia diba, mukuabo wakamba ne, Bulelela, muntu eu wakadi ne Yesu, bualu bua yeye udi Muena Galela.
Kadi Petelo wakamba ne, Mulumiana, tshiena mumanye tshiudi wamba. Hakadiye wakula nunku, tshitala tshiakasama.
Mukelenge wakatshinguluka, wakatangila Petelo talala. Petelo wakavuluka dî dia Mukelenge diakamuambileye ne, Tshitala katshi tshianze kusama lelu, wewe neumpidie misangu isatu.
Wakaluhuka biandi, wakadila bikole.
Bakadi bakuata Yesu, bakamuseka, bakamukuma bisusu.
Bakamubuikila tshitambala ku mesu, bakamuambila ne, Amba bualu bûdi umona, wakukukuma nganyi?
Bakamuambila malu makuabo a bungi bamuhenda.
Hakatshia butuku, tshisumbu tshia bakulu ba bantu tshiakudisangisha, bakuidi banene ne bafundi; bakaya nʼandi ku tshilumbuluidi tshiabo, bakamuambila ne,
Biwikala Kilisto, utuambile. Kadi yeye wakabambila ne, Binanuambila, kanuena nuitabusha;
bianukonka bualu, kanuena nunkudimuna.
Kadi ha dituku edi tô ne tshiendelele Muana wa muntu neashikame ku tshianza tshia balume tshia bukole bua Nzambi.
Buonso buabo bakamukosa ne, Wewe udi Muana wa Nzambi, anyi? Yeye wakabakudimuna dî ne, Nudi nuamba mundi yeye.
Bakamba ne, Tudi ne bualu bua bamanyi kabidi kudi kunyi? Tuetu tuakudiunvuila mei a mukana muandi mene.
